==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon Master Journeys - The Complete Collection was released on May 23, 2023 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains five discs with 42 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000093531. Optional English closed captioning is included.

Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature.
